comment: Bind inactive watch state to native writer ownership, physical completed-runtime invocation evidence, authenticated TCP lifecycle controls and a durable exact-instance journal; retain private reserved-child endpoint custody across crashes, preserve native routing generations and sticky publication history through attributable guarded rollback, distinguish original native process exit from denied or unknown crash evidence without signaling authority, recover cold marker/manifest selection through canonical completed-slot CAS without starting an owner, require explicit terminal archival before a new transaction, bound preflight/control/confirmation and transport completion to one deadline, permit only exact passive cleanup under default-off policy, and preserve pending custody and shared guard ownership. Governed stop records exact archived withdrawal custody, revalidates after quiescence, proves original exit and writer availability before native route CAS, and preserves generation/history for restart and protected-publication recovery. Cell installers prepare content-addressed immutable input through the canonical release materializer and provenance-last publication, reject partial or changed snapshots, build completed targets, and cold-activate without starting an owner.
